title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Judges 3: the judges Othniel, Ehud and Shamgar deliver Israel.

questions.text: Among the nations Yahweh left to test Israel were the five lords of which people?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:3 lists the five lords of the Philistines among the nations that were left.

questions.text: Into whose hand did Yahweh sell Israel for eight years?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:8 says Yahweh sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia, whom they served eight years.

questions.text: Whom did Yahweh raise up as a savior against Cushan Rishathaim?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:9 says Yahweh raised up Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.

questions.text: How long did the land have rest before Othniel died?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:11 says the land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

questions.text: What is said about Ehud the son of Gera?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:15 calls Ehud the son of Gera a Benjamite, a left-handed man.

answers.text: He was a priest from Judah
He was a very tall Ephraimite
He was a shepherd from Dan

questions.text: Where did Ehud wear the sword he had made?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:16 says he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh.

answers.text: Hidden in a basket of tribute
On his left side over his cloak
Under his clothing on his right thigh

questions.text: How is Eglon king of Moab described?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:17 says Eglon was a very fat man.

questions.text: When Eglon's servants found the doors locked, what did they assume?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:24 says they said, "Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room."

answers.text: That he was covering his feet
That he was counting the tribute

questions.explanation: Judges 3:26 says Ehud passed beyond the stone idols and escaped to Seirah.

questions.text: With what did Shamgar the son of Anath strike six hundred Philistines?
questions.explanation: Judges 3:31 says Shamgar struck six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad.
